lines.text: Baby, this ain't nothing like it should be / Stay in the mood, swing and the view ain't good for me / Getting high over nothing / Baby, when I'm drinking, I go all in

Out here living like I'm young, never gonna give it up / Smoking on a zip in a new whip / Saying, "If I think she acting jealous, go get better friends" / 'Cause you need room to breathe / I need you can't breathe
You are my hard place / I don't want to be finished / 'Cause we ain't got no limits / I know I gotta leave, mmm / But damn, if that ain't easy
I can't give up that easy, no, no, no / Give up that easy, no, no, no / I can't give it up, I can't give it up, no, no, no / 'Cause you are my hard place, whoa
How dare I say she wanna leave me? / Just for one night I'm begging on my knees / Baby, let me sleep your pain away / If after it all, I pulled away / Why you giving me a hard time?
I notice when I'm not with you, what we have is a hard time / What we have is a hard time / You, you're my hard place, can't escape / You're only happy when you know our love is in danger
Ooh, you know our love is in trouble if it's not your way / And if I don't give you rush hour when you don't get what you want / But all I need is your love whenever I need you to rush my way
